name: offsite-backup
description: Copy every new backup to another folder/NAS (or run a command such as rclone), with retention
author: the-isle-dedicated-server

DEST_DIR.description: Folder to copy backups into (e.g. /mnt/nas/theisle or \\NAS\backups)

KEEP.description: Backups to keep in DEST_DIR (0 = keep all)

COMMAND.description: Optional command run per backup, {file} is the backup path (e.g. rclone copy {file} remote:theisle)

usage: isle-server plugins config offsite-backup DEST_DIR=/mnt/nas/theisle KEEP=30
isle-server plugins run offsite-backup      # copy the newest backup now
